purpose: Every date on which a US mortgage rule constant stops being valid or its replacement is expected, from FinanceRateCalc's dated rule files. Subscribe: rule-calendar.ics. Not legal advice; expected dates are patterns of recent years, not commitments.

preregistered_prediction.text: Prediction (2026-10-18): on 2027-01-02 at least 20 public GitHub repositories will present a 2026 conforming or FHA limit as the current value.
preregistered_prediction.method: scripts/stale_constant_scan.mjs with the 2026 values as the stale set

events.title: Expected: FHFA announces 2027 conforming loan limits
events.detail: FHFA announced the 2026 values on 2025-11-25 and the 2025 values on 2024-11-26; the last Tuesday of November is the pattern, not a commitment. When the release appears, the 2027 rule file is drafted the same day and published after a human check.
events.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency, news release 2025-11-25

events.title: Expected: HUD Mortgagee Letter with 2027 FHA forward loan limits
events.detail: HUD published ML 2025-23 (the 2026 limits) on 2025-12-11, about two weeks after FHFA. Expected, not promised.

events.title: Expected: CFPB publishes 2027 HOEPA and QM thresholds
events.detail: The 2026 thresholds were published 2025-12-15 (90 FR). Expected, not promised.

events.title: Last valid day: Conforming loan limit values for mortgages acquired by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac in 2026
events.detail: Values in this table stop being valid after this date. Code and content that still carry them on the next day are stale. Rule Watch warns 75 days before.
events.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency, news release 2025-11-25

events.title: Last valid day: FHA forward mortgage loan limits for case numbers assigned on or after 2026-01-01
events.detail: Values in this table stop being valid after this date. Code and content that still carry them on the next day are stale. Rule Watch warns 75 days before.

events.title: Last valid day: Regulation Z 2026 annual threshold adjustments: HOEPA and qualified-mortgage points-and-fees
events.detail: Values in this table stop being valid after this date. Code and content that still carry them on the next day are stale. Rule Watch warns 75 days before.

events.title: 2027 values take effect: FHA limits, conforming limits, HOEPA/QM thresholds
events.detail: Every 2026 limit becomes a historical value. Anything that says 'the 2027 limit is $832,750' is wrong from this day. The public re-scan of stale constants runs on 2027-01-02 and is published as eval/stale-constants-scan-2027-01-02.json.
events.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency, news release 2025-11-25

events.title: Pre-registered re-scan: how much public code still carries 2026 limits
events.detail: Pre-registered 2026-10-18. The same stale-constant scan that found 29 repositories with 2025 values in October 2026 runs on this date against the 2026 values, and its result is published unedited. Prediction: at least 20 public repositories will carry a 2026 limit as current on 2027-01-02.
events.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency, news release 2025-11-25

events.title: No scheduled end: FHA annual mortgage insurance premium (MIP) rates, forward mortgages
events.detail: In force since 2023-03-20 with no end date; changes only when the issuer publishes a new letter or the statute changes.
events.source: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Mortgagee Letter 2023-05

events.title: No scheduled end: VA home loan funding fee percentages
events.detail: In force since 2023-04-07 with no end date; changes only when the issuer publishes a new letter or the statute changes.
events.source: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs; rates set by the Blue Water Navy Vietnam Veterans Act (P.L. 116-23) as reduced effective 2023-04-07
